1  CHINNAMARIAMMAN KOIL STREET  TIRUCHENAGODE  -2-  NC: 2025:KHC:900  MFA No. 572 of 2022  NAJMAKKAL DISTRICT  TAMIL NADU-637 211  ...RESPONDENTS (BY SMT. HARINI SHIVANANDA, ADVOCATE FOR R1;
 VIDE ORDER DTD.21.08.2024 APPEAL  AGAINST R2 STANDS ABATED)
 THIS MFA IS FILED U/S 173(1) OF MV ACT AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 10.03.2020 PASSED IN MVC NO.9006/2008 ON THE FILE OF THE XVI ADDITIONAL JUDGE,
COURT OF SMALL CAUSES, MEMBER, MACT, BENGALURU SCCH-14, PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.
 THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR DISMISSAL, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE PRADEEP SINGH YERUR  ORAL JUDGMENT There is no representation on behalf of the appellant.
Learned counsel for respondent No.1 is present.
The claim petition is allowed partly as against respondent No.2, who is dead and the appeal as against respondent No.2 is abated.
Legal representatives have NC: 2025:KHC:900 not been brought on record.
It appears that the appellant is not interested in proceeding further in the matter.
Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed for non- prosecution.
